caption: The drawing depicts a single, coiled horn with a circular shape, rendered in shades of brown with some lighter tan and cream-colored highlights and spots indicating areas of wear or reflection along its surface. The horn features a flared bell on the right side and a narrow, slightly ribbed mouthpiece on the left, connected by a smoothly curved, continuous tube that coils around itself approximately one and a half times. The background is a plain, light beige color, without any additional objects or detailing, and the artist's name, "FRITZ BOEHMER," is printed in small, neat letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Zoar Pottery Assembly Horn
